items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: But do you remember any of the names to Clayton Bolden? Or I don't know.

ctx.x: Yeah. He's a professional. Yeah. We have 6,000 pieces of music that belong here. Yeah.

He said he was the best band here. Oh yeah, he's a professor. He's a professor here. The band was coming. Did the band have piano out here? Huh? Did Robichaux's band have piano in the band over here? Oh yeah, they had piano, they had drums, piano, they had everything that would go to a band. Well, when you saw Buddy Bolden's band, did they have drummers in there? Yeah, everything. Yeah. Drummers, band, bass, bass, guitar. Yeah. They had guitar. How about? Violet. And then I had a saxophone. How about trombone?…
Did you know any of the men with Robichaux?
